audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is sold as Insanity Potion making you 'suddenly tanky enough to absorb her W-E burst', and no cooldown number appears anywhere.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in the lane and the only thing in her kit that can hold a running Singed. Repudiation is 18s, Lacerate 13s, Cunning Sweep 14s. Insanity Potion is 100s, Mega Adhesive 17s, Fling 10s. The real level-6 change is that her R answers your pattern, and yours answers her healing.
audit.corrected: 130s Public Execution, 18s Repudiation and Singed's 100/17/10 written into the cooldown row, spikes[1], mid and whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two invented mechanics and one invented ability. (a) 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability — it appears 25 times across the full layer as the thing to track. (b) 'her W dash' — W is Repudiation, a shield-and-brace, not a dash; her dashes are Drakehound's Step (P), Lacerate (E) and the Public Execution blink. (c) 'Mega Adhesive roots her mid-dash' and 'her E knockup' — the adhesive slows and GROUNDS, the root only happens when Fling drops her in it, and Lacerate slows, it does not knock up. The one fact that decides the lane, that grounding switches off all three of her dashes, is never stated.
audit.why: Riot text, Singed W: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it'. Singed E: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Ambessa W: 'gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground'. Ambessa E: 'damaging and slowing nearby enemies'. Ambessa P is the dash that empowers her next attack — that is the auto-reset tell to step back on.
audit.corrected: Every 'Repeating Dashes' is replaced with Public Execution, the real cooldown a Singed must track; the grounding, the Fling-into-adhesive root, Repudiation's shield and the Drakehound's Step auto tell are all stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown row tracked an ability that does not exist.
audit.why: Public Execution at 130s is the punishable window: with it down she cannot pin a Singed at all, and the whole lane is farmable.

edits.before: Level 3 gives you Mega Adhesive, which is the first real tool against a dash-heavy bruiser: throw it where she wants to land her W, and if she walks into it you root her and Fling her straight into your poison trail. At level 4-5 establish your proxy pattern — farm between her tower and her wave, forcing her to choose between CSing and chasing you through poison. She has the raw damage to kill you in those levels but only if she can stick to you, and your movement speed from Noxious Slipstream makes that difficult once you have read her dash angle. Level 6 with Insanity Potion is the turning point: the armor, MR, and regen absorb her W-E burst combo while you just keep running, and now your all-in with Fling-Adhesive-R is genuinely threatening.
edits.after: Level 3 gives you Mega Adhesive, the first real tool against a dash-heavy bruiser: it GROUNDS, so a glued Ambessa has no Drakehound's Step, no Lacerate dash and no Public Execution blink. Throw it where she wants to land, and Fling her back into it — landing in the adhesive is what roots her. At level 4-5 establish the proxy pattern, farming between her tower and her wave so she must choose between CS and chasing through poison. She has the damage to kill you there, but only if she can stick. Level 6 is the turning point both ways: Insanity Potion (100s) puts Grievous Wounds on your trail and halves the healing that wins her long trades, while her 130s Public Execution is the one lockdown your move speed cannot answer.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability and it was the tracked cooldown in 25 separate strings across the full layer. I replaced every instance with Public Execution, which is the same character length so all swaps clear the band, and it is genuinely the cooldown a Singed should track — 130s of blink-suppress is the only thing in her kit that holds a man running at 400+ move speed. Also removed: 'her W dash' (W is Repudiation, a shield), 'Mega Adhesive roots her mid-dash' (it grounds; the root needs a Fling), and 'her E knockup' (Lacerate slows). Per the mirror, the heal and grounding flags on Public Execution and Repudiation in champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json are spurious tooltip-parse artefacts and I asserted neither. report[8] still tells you to buy anti-heal 'because his healing fights your pattern' — Ambessa's healing is rune-based, not kit-based, so the advice survives, but the reason given is wrong; I left it rather than guess at 26.15 item timings.
